name: Youves uUSD
oneLiner: uUSD is Youves's overcollateralized CDP dollar on Tezos, minted against XTZ, tzBTC, USDt, or SIRS at collateral-specific target ratios with a savings pool.
collateral: XTZ, tzBTC, USDt, or SIRS (tez/tzBTC LP) in Tezos vaults. Official V3 documentation lists frontend targets/emergency ratios of 200%/160% for XTZ, 200%/135% for SIRS and one tzBTC engine, and 115%/110% for USDt and a separately listed tzBTC engine. Frontend target ratios are not enforced by V3 contracts. The separately listed 115%/110% tzBTC engine is not in the token-authorized census at level 15180739. Legacy v1/v2 documented targets were 300%.
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP on Tezos with variable collateral ratios; liquidations triggered at emergency ratio with 12.5% reward; savings pool provides additional peg stability
